Final phase: web options 25 to 27 September, allotment 29 September, college reporting 30 September to 1 October.
If your allotment came today, complete self-reporting and college reporting inside the window. A missed date can cancel the seat.
ANGRAU agriculture and food technology (AP EAPCET rank)
Phase I web options ran 24 to 26 September. The university shows a later application window that closes 29 September.
Check the ANGRAU admissions page tonight for the next dated step, and keep local-status and farmers-quota papers ready.
Telangana BSc Nursing (TG EAPCET rank, KNRUHS)
Registration ran 16 to 24 September and was extended to 27 September. It has closed.
If you registered, watch the KNRUHS site for the merit list and seat numbers, which the prospectus says will be notified before web options.
Andhra Pradesh BSc Nursing (NEET UG rank, Dr NTR UHS)
Applications opened 9 September and were extended to 22 September. It has closed.
Watch the university site for the state merit list built on NEET rank.
AP allied health and paramedical degrees (NTRUHS)
The notification is reported as expected from late September to early October. Nothing official is confirmed yet.
Do not pay any agent for a promised seat. Wait for the university notice and read the eligibility line for your own course.

Andhra Pradesh BiPC stream, qualifiers to counselling seats
63,546 qualified in AP EAPCET agriculture and pharmacy. 13,052 seats in phase 1 counselling.
63,546 ÷ 13,052 = 4.9 qualifiers per seat. Only 23,614 registered for counselling, so 23,614 ÷ 13,052 = 1.8 registrants per seat.
Andhra Pradesh phase 1 result
12,226 seats filled out of 13,052. B.Pharm: 10,142 filled of 10,958.
12,226 ÷ 13,052 = 93.7 percent filled. 12,226 ÷ 23,614 = 51.8 percent of registrants got a seat. 13,052 - 12,226 = 826 vacant after round one.
Telangana BiPC stream, qualifiers to counselling seats
73,294 qualified in TG EAPCET agriculture and pharmacy. Phase 1 lists 8,473 B.Pharm, 1,567 Pharm.D, 239 biotech, 170 pharmaceutical sciences and 37 biomedical seats.
Telangana nursing eligibility line
73,294 qualified. General nursing line at rank 42,477.
73,294 - 42,477 = 30,817 qualified candidates rank below the general line. About 58 percent of qualifiers sit inside it.

84,954 appeared in TG EAPCET agri-pharm. Percentile ranks in the KNRUHS notice: 42,477, 46,724, 50,972.
84,954 x 0.50 = 42,477. 84,954 x 0.55 = 46,724.7. 84,954 x 0.60 = 50,972.4. The percentile lines are counted on candidates who appeared, not on those who qualified.

Pharmacist, private employer
A wide band. Roles in quality, regulatory and research sit higher than counter pharmacy.
"BSc Nursing needs NEET everywhere."
Only in Andhra Pradesh among these two states. The Telangana 2026-27 notice ranks candidates on TG EAPCET and says NEET UG is not required.
"BSc Nursing needs no NEET anywhere."
Andhra Pradesh asks applicants to have appeared in NEET UG 2026 and ranks the state list on it.
"BVSc means NEET, full stop."
The 15 percent VCI quota and the management seats use NEET. The Telangana state seats use TG EAPCET ranks, and Andhra Pradesh state seats are reported to use AP EAPCET.
"Qualifying in EAPCET means a nursing seat."
Not in Telangana. Qualifying is not the line. The general nursing line is rank 42,477, and 30,817 qualified candidates sit below it.
"Pharmacy is a fallback with no competition."
Seats are plentiful, but the top university colleges close at low ranks. Seat-rich does not mean every seat is good.
"BiPC students cannot do engineering."
BiPC counselling includes biotechnology, food technology, agricultural and pharmaceutical engineering seats. JEE Main B.E. and B.Tech still needs Mathematics.

blocks.heading: Pay Starts Modestly

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: The most seat-rich door: 10,958 B.Pharm seats in AP phase 1 alone and 8,473 in Telangana. Pay starts modestly. AmbitionBox lists pharmacists at Rs 1.2 to 4.1 lakh a year from 23,200 salary reports (July 2025), with freshers at Rs 1 to 4 lakh. Quality assurance, regulatory work, clinical research and an owned pharmacy are where pay separates.

supporting: No entrance entry requirement and no rank pressure, which is exactly why the outcome depends on what you add. A student who pairs the degree with data handling, lab method and one published piece of work can sell the skill across employers and remotely. OAMDC lists about 4.9 lakh seats in more than 1,300 colleges and Telangana DOST about 4.2 lakh in 978-plus colleges, across all streams, so seats are never the limit.

The most seat-rich door: 10,958 B.Pharm seats in AP phase 1 alone and 8,473 in Telangana. Pay starts modestly. AmbitionBox lists pharmacists at Rs 1.2 to 4.1 lakh a year from 23,200 salary reports (July 2025), with freshers at Rs 1 to 4 lakh. Quality assurance, regulatory work, clinical research and an owned pharmacy are where pay separates.

blocks.heading: Hospitals Need Nurses, Farms Need Advisers, Plants

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Hospitals need nurses, farms need advisers, plants need quality staff. Ask how many people your college sends into each role and how many of those roles pay above Rs 3 lakh.
